name: Running
summary: Walking on the spot with the carriage pressed out: one knee bends as the other heel drops under the bar.
steps: Start as for heel raises, legs pressed out straight and heels lifted.
Breathe in, bend one knee and let the opposite heel drop under the bar.
Breathe out, rise through both feet until both legs are straight.

layers.title: Quicker
layers.text: Two changes per breath, still controlled.

cautions.note: Lying flat on the back: keep it to a few minutes, raise the head end if you can, and stop if she feels dizzy.

cues:
Pass through two straight legs each time — a tiny pause at the top.
Hips stay level; no rocking side to side.
Knees track over the second toe.
Straight legs, not locked knees.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Take a spring off if needed
